reuse.why: Puts the daily-skip rule beside getDateWithSkippedWeekend, the shared weekend decision, as extra branches in getNextDate instead of extending that helper or a shared rule that its other callers use.

duplication.why: The `frequency === 'daily' && skipWeekend && !noSkipWeekend` test is written three times in one function, and the look-ahead loop is followed by two redundant weekend re-checks.

placement.why: shared/schedules.ts is the right module, but the rule lives only in getNextDate while getUpcomingDates (schedules/app.ts) and schedule-template.ts make the same weekend decision themselves.

scope.why: Only getNextDate and its tests change.

maintainability.why: Branchy special cases with repeated conditions, reading frequency from the raw condition while the rest uses value.schedule.data, and a rule that the other weekend paths do not share.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getNextDate in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts adds its own daily weekend branches around getDateWithSkippedWeekend instead of routing the rule through it

one_place.where: Only getNextDate in shared/schedules.ts applies the daily skip; getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and both nextDate computations in server/budget/schedule-template.ts still move daily weekend occurrences with getDateWithSkippedWeekend
